label: ports-chainseed-probe
_why: THE §2 CHAIN-SEED PROBE (user-directed 2026-08-16 evening): the graded-port probe measured ZERO metal shipyards built world-wide in 15 years against standing steamer demand from the engine's own steam-port stubs (GBR buys 0.6-1.5 steamers/wk with no producer on Earth; steam stubs at -80/wk) - the chicken-and-egg the user's seed plan targets. This arm = canonical graded config + the chain seed now in config/start_exceptions.json: 13 leader-owned anchorages in the GBR/FRA markets (the two 1836 markets whose leader holds screw_frigate day 0) start as t1 steam stubs at level 1, and each leader gets ONE metal shipyard converted from a small clipper-shipyard block (GBR East Anglia 3 lv, FRA Brittany 1 lv). Steel NOT seeded (GBR Yorkshire 6 lv + FRA Alsace 1 lv exist in vanilla history); engines NOT seeded per the stop-there rule (GBR has Yorkshire motor 1 lv; FRA has NO engine source - expect its yard to limp on an engines shortage, that is a reading not a defect). Subject-owned anchorages EXCLUDED by landmine L14 (their owners cannot unlock the building; preflight caught it live on the first dry run). READ: (1) does the seeded yard SURVIVE and supply the stubs, or shed to zero like everything else - the steamer market's price series (market_goods_scoped, first time recorded for this question); (2) where does the MM price sit in the GBR/FRA markets (the user's standing question - not measurable in the bare probe, which ran without market telemetry); (3) do the seeded stubs STAY staffed or destaff into the same ~5/wk MM-demand floor (canonical nice_to_have = no subsidies, majors pay GBP 0 - measured); (4) does the engine re-provision SAIL ports into the seeded states (their anchorage was converted away - unknown interaction, queue_mix shows it); (5) steel/engines prices under the new yard demand; (6) the usual queue mix + NET/SPA/POR delayed waves.
_arms: chainseed = {kind: config, config: config/mod_config.json} - the CANONICAL config (graded ports §10.60.2 + nice_to_have + F61) with the chain-seed rules LIVE in config/start_exceptions.json (committed; _why_chain_seed there holds the full derivation). Dry-run verified incl. preflight (L14 clean after the leader-only restriction).
_comparison: ports-graded-probe 20260816_202628 is the exact no-seed baseline (same config minus the 15 exception rules, same span): GBR ports destaff to s4/MM 5 by 1841, zero yards world-wide, steamers bought 0.6-1.5/wk phantom. vancost-nosub-n2 20260816_011552 = the pre-factorisation shape.
_cost: 1 run x 16 in-game years, ~20 min wall.
